text:
Happy Veterans Day evening. We're sitting in the mid 40s under a lid of cloud, and sunset is at 4:29, so don't expect any color. It'll just fade to gray. Tonight stays mostly cloudy and quiet, with the temperature sliding to around 31 by morning, so bundle up a bit if you're out late.

Thursday is the wet one. Rain moves in around 10 in the morning and is steadiest from about noon to 4, with a high near 43. It doesn't look like much, about a tenth of an inch, but the European model and ICON are wetter than the official forecast, so I'd carry the umbrella and plan outdoor errands for the morning. As it cools Thursday night, the rain turns to a rain and snow mix, with the best chance of flakes in the small hours Friday. The ground is still too warm for anything to stick in town, so expect wet pavement rather than a shoveling job. Friday brightens up a touch but stays chilly, in the low 40s.

week.blurb: Mostly cloudy and chilly for Veterans Day, a high near 46 and dry, dropping to around 31 tonight.
Rain and snow mix moving in after 7am, light with under a tenth of an inch, high near 43, turning more wintry tonight.
Cloudy and raw, high near 41 with a few rain and snow flakes around midday, barely a dusting at most, and a breezy north wind.
Mostly cloudy and breezy, high near 42, with a coin-flip chance of a rain and snow mix, so keep the jacket handy.
A little rain early, then maybe a flurry or mixed shower by midday, high near 43, with the odds trending lower.
Looks like a drier start to the week, partly sunny and a bit chilly with a high near 43 and a cold night.
Mostly sunny and the pick of the week, with a high near 45 and a light wind, if the pattern holds.
